paragraphs: We are a leading manufacturer of sustainable rigid packaging solutions for the world's essential consumer goods products. We had consolidated net sales of approximately $6.5 billion in 2025. Our products are used for a wide variety of end markets and we operate 121 manufacturing plants in North America, Europe, Asia and South America. Our products include:
•dispensing and specialty closures for fragrance and beauty, food, beverage, personal and health care, home care and lawn and garden products;
•steel and aluminum containers for pet and human food and general line products; and
•custom designed plastic containers for pet and human food, consumer health and pharmaceutical, personal care, home care, lawn and garden and automotive products.

We are a leading worldwide manufacturer and supplier of dispensing and specialty closures for the fragrance and beauty, food, beverage, personal and health care, home care and lawn and garden markets. Our leadership position in dispensing and specialty closures is a result of our ability to provide customers with market leading innovation and high levels of quality, service and technological support. Our dispensing and specialty closures business provides customers with an extensive variety of innovative dispensing systems and proprietary specialty closures solutions that ensure closure quality and safety, as well as state-of-the-art capping/sealing equipment and detection systems to complement our product offering. We have 63 dispensing and specialty closure manufacturing facilities located in North America, Europe, Asia and South America, from which we serve over 100 countries throughout the world. We also have three joint ventures for dispensing and specialty closure products in countries that we do not serve directly. In addition, we license our technology for metal closures to five other manufacturers for various markets that we do not serve directly. For 2025, our dispensing and specialty closures business had net sales of $2.7 billion (approximately 41.8 percent of our consolidated net sales) and income before interest and income taxes (EBIT) of $321.5 million (approximately 49.8 percent of our consolidated EBIT excluding corporate expense).

We are also a leading manufacturer and supplier of metal containers in North America and Europe, and in North America we are the largest manufacturer of metal food containers with a unit volume market share in the United States in 2025 of more than half of the market. Our leadership in these markets is driven by our high levels of quality, service and technological support, our low cost producer position, our strong long-term customer relationships and our proximity to customers through our widespread geographic presence. We have 37 metal container manufacturing facilities located in the United States, Europe and Asia, serving over 50 countries throughout the world. Additionally, we believe that we have the most comprehensive equipment capabilities in the industry. For 2025, our metal containers business had net sales of $3.1 billion (approximately 48.4 percent of our consolidated net sales) and EBIT of $243.4 million (approximately 37.7 percent of our consolidated EBIT excluding corporate expense).

Additionally, we are a leading manufacturer and supplier of custom containers in North America for a variety of markets, including the pet and human food, consumer health and pharmaceutical, personal care, home care, lawn and garden and automotive markets. Our success with custom containers is largely due to our demonstrated ability to provide our customers with high levels of quality, service and technological support, along with our value-added design-focused products and our extensive geographic presence with 21 manufacturing facilities in the United States and Canada. We produce custom containers from a full range of resin materials and offer a comprehensive array of molding and decorating capabilities. For 2025, our custom containers business had net sales of $637.6 million (approximately 9.8 percent of our consolidated net sales) and EBIT of $81.1 million (approximately 12.5 percent of our consolidated EBIT excluding corporate expense).

Our customer base includes some of the world's best-known branded consumer products companies. Our philosophy has been to develop long-term customer relationships by acting in partnership with our customers by providing market leading innovation and reliable quality, service and technological support and utilizing our low cost producer position. The strength of our customer relationships is evidenced by our large number of multi-year supply arrangements, our high retention of customers' business and our continued recognition from customers, as demonstrated by the many quality and service awards we have received. We estimate that in 2026 approximately 90 percent of our projected metal container sales and a majority of our projected dispensing and specialty closures and custom container sales will be under multi-year customer supply arrangements.

Our objective is to increase shareholder value by efficiently deploying capital and management resources to grow our business through acquisitions and organically, reduce operating costs and build sustainable competitive positions, or franchises. We believe that we will accomplish this goal because of our leading market positions and management expertise in acquiring, financing, integrating and efficiently operating consumer goods packaging businesses.

We are a Delaware corporation. We were founded in 1987 by R. Philip Silver and D. Greg Horrigan. Since our inception, we have acquired forty-one businesses. Through acquisitions and organic growth, we have become a leading worldwide manufacturer and supplier of dispensing and specialty closures for the fragrance and beauty, food, beverage, personal and health care, home care and lawn and garden markets, with net sales for the dispensing and specialty closures business of $2.7 billion in 2025, representing a compound annual growth rate of approximately 12.4 percent since our acquisition of the White Cap closures operations in the United States in 2003. As a result of the benefits of acquisitions and organic growth, we have become a leading manufacturer and supplier of metal containers in North America and Europe, with net sales for the metal containers business of $3.1 billion in 2025, representing a compound annual growth rate of approximately 6.8 percent since 1987, and have increased our overall share of the metal food container market in the United States from approximately ten percent in 1987 to more than half of the market in 2025. We have also grown our market position in the custom container business since 1987, with net sales for the custom container business increasing to $637.6 million in 2025, representing a compound annual growth rate of approximately 5.3 percent over that period. The following chart shows our acquisitions since our inception:
Nestlé Food Company's metal container manufacturing division 1987 Metal food containers Monsanto Company's custom container business 1987 Custom containers
Fort Madison Can Company of The Dial Corporation 1988 Metal food containers Seaboard Carton Division of Nestlé Food Company
1988 Paperboard containers Aim Packaging, Inc. 1989 Custom containers Fortune Plastics Inc. 1989 Custom containers
Express Plastic Containers Limited 1989 Custom containers Amoco Container Company 1989 Custom containers

The following are certain risk factors that could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently view as immaterial may also materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.
RISKS RELATED TO BUSINESS, OPERATIONS AND CERTAIN FINANCIAL MATTERS
WE FACE COMPETITION FROM MANY COMPANIES AND WE MAY LOSE SALES OR EXPERIENCE LOWER MARGINS ON SALES AS A RESULT OF SUCH COMPETITION.

The manufacture and sale of dispensing and specialty closures, metal containers and custom containers is highly competitive. We compete with other manufacturers of these products and manufacturers of alternative packaging products, as well as packaged goods companies who manufacture closures and containers for their own use and for sale to others. We compete primarily on the basis of price, quality and service. To the extent that any of our competitors is able to offer better prices, quality and/or services, we could lose customers and our sales and margins may decline.

In 2025, approximately 90 percent of our metal container sales and a majority of our dispensing and specialty closures and custom container sales were pursuant to multi-year supply arrangements. Although no assurances can be given, we have been successful historically in continuing these multi-year customer supply arrangements. Additionally, in general, many of these arrangements provide that during the term the customer may receive competitive proposals for all or up to a portion of the products we furnish to the customer. We have the right to retain the business subject to the terms and conditions of the competitive proposal. If we match a competitive proposal, it may result in reduced sales prices for the products that are the subject of the proposal. If we choose not to match a competitive proposal, we may lose the sales that were the subject of the proposal. Moreover, due to our fixed costs, we may be unable to maintain our margins at past levels if we are not able to achieve capacity utilization rates similar to prior periods in our manufacturing facilities.

The loss of any major customer, a significant reduction in the purchasing levels of any major customer, whether due to competition, customer consolidation, inventory destocking, weather related events or any other reason, or a significant adverse change in the terms of our supply agreement with any major customer could adversely affect our results of operations.

paragraphs: 本公司為全球重要消費性商品產品之可持續性堅硬包裝解決方案之領導製造商。本公司於2025年合併後淨銷售額約為65億美元。本公司產品應用於廣泛之最終市場，並於北美、歐洲、亞洲及南美洲設有121家製造廠。本公司產品包括：
•為香水與美容、食品、飲料、個人與健康照護、家庭照護及園藝產品所設計之灌裝與專用封口器；
•用於寵物與人類食品及一般線產品之鋼製與鋁製容器；以及
•為寵物與人類食品、消費性健康與藥品、個人護理、家庭照護、園藝及汽車產品所設計之客製化塑膠容器。

本公司為全球領先的散裝容器及專業封口零組件製造商與供應商，服務於香氛與美容、食品與飲料、個人與健康照護、居家照護及園藝與園區市場。本公司在散裝容器及專業封口零組件領域的領導地位，係因本公司能為客戶提供市場領先的創新技術與高水準的品質、服務及技術支援。本公司散裝容器及專業封口零組件業務，為客戶提供廣泛的創新散裝系統與專利專業封口解決方案，確保封口品質與安全性，並搭配最先進的蓋裝/密封設備與檢測系統，以補強產品組合。本公司在全球北美洲、歐洲、亞洲及南美洲設有63家散裝容器及專業封口零組件製造廠，服務全球超過100個國家。本公司亦在不直接服務的國家設有三個合資企業，專門製造散裝容器及專業封口零組件。此外，本公司將金屬封口技術授權給五家其他製造商，服務於本公司不直接服務的市場。2025年，本公司散裝容器及專業封口零組件業務的淨銷售額為2.7十億美元（約佔本公司合併淨銷售額的41.8％），營業收入（EBIT）為321.5百萬美元（約佔本公司合併營業收入（EBIT）扣除公司總部費用後的49.8％）。

本公司亦為北美洲與歐洲的金屬容器領先製造商與供應商。在北美洲，本公司為美國最大的金屬食品容器製造商，2025年美國市場的單元體積市佔率超過一半。本公司在這些市場的領導地位，係因本公司提供高水準的品質、服務與技術支援，具備低成本生產優勢，擁有強大的長期客戶關係，並透過廣泛的地理佈局接近客戶。本公司在美國、歐洲與亞洲設有37家金屬容器製造廠，服務全球超過50個國家。此外，本公司認為本公司擁有業界最完整的設備能力。2025年，本公司金屬容器業務的淨銷售額為3.1十億美元（約佔本公司合併淨銷售額的48.4％），營業收入（EBIT）為243.4百萬美元（約佔本公司合併營業收入（EBIT）扣除公司總部費用後的37.7％）。

此外，本公司為北美洲多種市場的客製化容器領先製造商與供應商，包括寵物與人類食品、消費健康與藥品、個人護理、居家照護、園藝與園區及汽車市場。本公司在客製化容器業務的成功，主要歸功於本公司展示出的高水準品質、服務與技術支援能力，以及本公司具價值的設計導向產品，以及本公司在美國與加拿大設有21家製造廠的廣泛地理佈局。本公司可從完整的樹脂材料範疇製造客製化容器，並提供廣泛的成型與裝飾能力。2025年，本公司客製化容器業務的淨銷售額為637.6百萬美元（約佔本公司合併淨銷售額的9.8％），營業收入（EBIT）為81.1百萬美元（約佔本公司合併營業收入（EBIT）扣除公司總部費用後的12.5％）。

本公司客戶包括全球知名之品牌消費性商品公司。本公司哲學為透過與客戶合作，提供市場領先之創新與可靠之品質、服務與科技支援，並運用本公司低成本生產優勢，以建立長期客戶關係。本公司客戶關係之強大，體現在本公司擁有大量多年供應協議、高客戶業務留存率，以及客戶持續認可本公司，如本公司所獲得多項品質與服務獎項。本公司估計，於2026年，約90%預計之金屬容器銷售與多數預計之灌裝與專用封口器及客製化容器銷售將透過多年客戶供應協議進行。
本公司之目標為透過收購及內生成長，有效運用資本及管理資源以拓展業務，降低營運成本並建立可持續之競爭優勢或品牌。本公司相信能達成此目標，因本公司擁有領導市場地位及在收購、融資、整合及高效運作消費性商品包裝業務之管理專業知識。

本公司為德拉瓦州公司。本公司於1987年由R. Philip Silver及D. Greg Horrigan創立。自本公司成立以來，已收購四十一家企業。透過收購及內生成長，本公司已成為全球領先之散裝容器及特殊封口產品製造與供應商，服務香氛與美容、食品、飲料、個人與健康照護、家庭照護及園藝市場，散裝容器及特殊封口產品之淨銷售額於2025年為27億美元，自2003年收購美國White Cap封口產品業務以來，複合年成長率約為12.4%。因收購及內生成長之效益，本公司已成為北美及歐洲領先之金屬容器製造與供應商，金屬容器業務之淨銷售額於2025年為31億美元，自1987年起複合年成長率約為6.8%，並於美國金屬食品容器市場之市佔率從1987年約10%成長至2025年逾半數。本公司亦於1987年起擴大在客製容器業務之市場地位，客製容器業務之淨銷售額於2025年為6.376億美元，複合年成長率約為5.3%。下圖顯示本公司自成立以來之收購情形：
Nestlé Food Company之金屬容器製造部門 1987 金屬食品容器 Monsanto Company之客製容器業務 1987 客製容器
Fort Madison Can Company of The Dial Corporation 1988 金屬食品容器 Seaboard Carton Division of Nestlé Food Company
1988 紙板容器 Aim Packaging, Inc. 1989 客製容器 Fortune Plastics Inc. 1989 客製容器
Express Plastic Containers Limited 1989 客製容器 Amoco Container Company 1989 客製容器
以下為可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利影響的風險因素。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知或被視為不重要，亦可能對本公司業務、財務狀況或營運成果造成重大且不利影響。
與業務、營運及某些財務事項相關的風險
本公司面臨來自許多公司的競爭，因此可能因競爭而失去銷售或遭遇銷售毛利率下降。
散裝容器與特殊封口、金屬容器及客製容器的製造與銷售屬高度競爭產業。本公司與這些產品的其他製造商、替代包裝產品製造商以及自行製造封口與容器的包裝商品公司競爭。本公司主要以價格、品質與服務作為競爭基礎。若任何競爭對手能提供更優的價格、品質與/或服務，本公司可能失去客戶，且銷售與毛利率可能下降。

2025年，本公司約90％的金屬容器銷售以及大部分的散裝容器與特殊封口及客製容器銷售均係根據多年供應協議進行。雖然無法保證，但本公司歷來成功延續這些多年客戶供應協議。此外，一般而言，許多這些協議規定，在協議期間內，客戶可針對本公司提供予客戶的全部或部分產品收到競爭性提案。本公司有權保留該業務，但須符合競爭性提案的條件與限制。若本公司匹配競爭性提案，可能導致該提案所涉產品的銷售價格下降。若本公司選擇不匹配競爭性提案，則可能失去該提案所涉的銷售。此外，由於本公司固定成本，若無法在製造設施中達到與過去期間相似的產能利用率，本公司可能無法維持過去的毛利率水平。
任何主要客戶的流失、任何主要客戶購買量顯著減少（無論因競爭、客戶併購、存貨去庫存、天氣相關事件或其他原因），或與任何主要客戶的供應協議條款發生顯著不利變更，均可能對本公司營運成果造成不利影響。
